courses.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
courses.summary: The Bachelor of Business Administration is an undergraduate management degree taken after secondary school. Core study covers accounting, finance, marketing, organisational behaviour, human resource management, operations, business law and economics, usually followed by a specialisation such as business analytics, international business, digital marketing, finance or healthcare management, plus an internship or live project. Programmes run for three years in many systems and four years where an honours or research year is added. Graduates move into entry-level management roles or continue to an MBA or a specialist master's degree.

courses.name: Bachelor of Computer Applications
courses.summary: The Bachelor of Computer Applications is an undergraduate computing degree focused on programming, software development and applied information technology rather than engineering science. Typical coursework covers programming languages, data structures, database systems, operating systems, computer networks, web and mobile development, software engineering and discrete mathematics, with electives in areas such as data science, cyber security or cloud computing. The degree usually lasts three years, or four with an honours or research year, and commonly leads to software and IT roles or to a Master of Computer Applications.

universities.summary: Ponnaiyah Ramajayam Institute of Science and Technology, known as PRIST, is a private deemed-to-be university at Vallam, Thanjavur. Its main-campus portfolio includes science, humanities, commerce, computing, business and agriculture. Programme qualifications, study modes and campus-specific fees should be compared separately.
universities.campusLifestyle: The main campus is on the Thanjavur–Trichy Highway at Vallam. University departments bring together classroom study, laboratories, library resources and student activities. Confirm the actual programme schedule, teaching language and residential arrangements before accepting an offer.
universities.cityProfile: Vallam is outside Thanjavur city on the highway towards Tiruchirappalli. PRIST gives its main-campus address as Thanjavur–Trichy Highways, Vallam, Tamil Nadu 613403. Plan daily travel or accommodation around this location; another PRIST-named campus is a separate teaching-site choice.
universities.practicalExposure: The science departments describe laboratory study alongside classroom learning, while agriculture includes field-oriented study and laboratories in areas such as agronomy, plant pathology and entomology. Commerce, business and computing use their programme curricula and projects. Practical work differs by award; a degree does not guarantee a professional licence, internship allocation or employment.

universities.dietarySupport: Confirm the hostel’s current meal arrangements, charges and any dietary requirements before accepting accommodation. No special-menu or medically tailored meal guarantee is established by the reviewed fee schedule.
universities.safetyOverview: The university publishes Anti-Ragging, Internal Complaints and Student Grievance Redressal resources. Keep current campus reporting contacts and travel arrangements available; these resources do not imply a general safety guarantee.
universities.studentSupport: The university provides admission, grievance and student-support routes. Applicants should keep qualifying marksheets, degree records and applicable category certificates ready, and confirm equivalence, actual selection requirements and any concessions individually.
